text:
## CHANGES TO RATES (NOTICE)  
**Next Rate Review:** February 15, 2026
**Typical Review Cycle:** Monthly
**Customer Notification:** Email + SMS (if opted in) + website
**Effective Date:** 1st of month following review  
**No Guarantee:** FirstUK reserves right to change rates without notice (within regulatory limits)
